incidents.name: ATM auto-swap sandwiched via transfer+skim
incidents.notes: The ATM token converts its accumulated fees by swapping ATM to WBNB and WBNB to USDT from inside _transfer with no slippage bound, so the attacker skewed the WBNB/ATM pair with a flash loan plus skim() and sandwiched the token's own swap.
